definitions: A graphical user interface element, typically a horizontal or vertical strip, that provides controls and options for initiating and configuring new tasks within a software application or system.
A dedicated section in an application's interface where users can input details, select parameters, and trigger the generation of a new task or work item.
examples: The task creation bar is located at the top of the project management software.
Click the plus icon on the task creation bar to add a new assignment.
Users can customize the fields available in the task creation bar.
